title: CRIC Human Applications and UI Specification
summary: Specifies CRIC human interfaces: twelve application modules, display contracts for evidence, provenance, contradictions and agents, accessibility, export formats and v0.1 acceptance criteria.
notes: Ambiguity resolved: PRD signals present (Primary User Groups section, 'Users should be able to' phrasing, closing 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section, path segment 'CRIC-PRD-v0.1'), but dominant content is interface contracts the system must honour — per-module display field lists, a named technology choice (MapLibre GL JS), export format list, and non-functional requirements (accessibility targets, 'Sensitive secrets must never be displayed', candidate knowledge visually distinguishable, evidence completeness visually distinct from risk state). H1 reads 'Specification'. SPEC also outranks PRD under the ambiguity rule. No frontmatter, no status field, no markdown links to sibling docs.
